title: Is a Boat Trip in Madeira a Good Idea When Pregnant?
description: It can be, if your doctor or midwife agrees. Choose a calm day, sit at the back, ask the skipper to go gently, drink plenty and stay in the shade on board.
heroAlt: Pregnant woman seen from behind resting at the back of the boat facing the cliffs of Cabo Girão
keywords: is a boat trip safe when pregnant
boat ride pregnancy what to know

images.prompt: Late afternoon on a calm sea below Cabo Girão, Madeira. Beyond her the huge dark cliff of Cabo Girão rises from the sea with terraced fields at its edge. Soft warm light, true colours, very calm water, no face visible.
